notes.title: Still Working, Guardians
notes.content:
Hello Guardians, It’s Marco and I wanted do share with a list of the new feature of the updated version of Edge Guardian we are working on.


 Oculus and oculus touch support
 Automatic switch between different HMDs (vive and oculus at the moment)
 New Interactions/animations of the hands
 Updated “energy wall” animations
 Updated Enemy animations
 Rewrited audio source management system to improve performance
 Updated enemy movement system to avoid some annoying bugs and streamline management.
 Enemies that hook up to “the core” are more hit-responsive (new spring system)
 Fixed some problems with the "shot" and collision of enemies.
 Updated the particle smoke system in the desert to improve performance
 Implemented FXAA Filter and Replaced Bloom Effect by - Postprocessing Counterparty (Low Impact on Performance/Improved Graphic Performance)
 Optimized desert scene for better performance
 VR rendering is now set to "single pass" with updated effects and full support (it translates into better performance).


Keep in mind that Vincenzo, the new programmer, have rewritten the game from ground up so we need more time to finish the product and be out of the Early Access.

I hope I can share some video of the new version in the next update and some to have good news in the next month. Thanks everyone for the support.

notes.title: Road to update 0.4
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26142227/3f1b7476c5b93593f84ffbeb1494b87e60d42f8d.gif

Hi Guardians, we are here to take all of you on the road trip to the updates 0.3 and 0.4

We are working on the first "boss" enemy of the game, of which you can spot a glimpse in the very end of the latest trailer

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3RmeTB1dRJA
this will take a little longer to be made: he changes some game mechanics, we need you to understand this or the fun on this experience is screwed!

So here is the catch: the enemy/boss will be implemented in a new tutorial that will take place in this arena

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26142227/637dd1666b61a11a285287a6a3383784fa9a5fe3.png

this is the naked model of the bonus stage from the version 0.4 of the game, so we think that with a little more effort we can bring the bonus stage and the new powers earlier in the roadmap.

Next step is the new environment

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26142227/155a3ca756f17dfaba6ec68e0073fd6a34285826.png

this level gifts you with a new enemy that you must deal with. It's a flying level so you have (almost) no possibility of gaining corpses to shot back at the foes!

Again, we need time to make the cloud layers work, the new enemy work and make some random things spawn to create an experience that is appealing, fun and somehow unconmfortable!

So support us if you can, and wait for these updates.
Thanks and see you later!

P.S.

Bugfix


no more invisible enemies
fixed enemies behavior on energy sucking
no more combo breaks on Crowd enemies
fixed an HEX line

Added Crowd enemy*
Added new Punches sounds as requested
Added 40 new quotes and lines for Hex

Fixed some enemy wave bugs

As usual, please let us know if you like the update and tell us if something doesn't work properly or needs improvement!
Thanks for your support.

notes.title: V.0.0.6 Fixes and Updates
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26142227/fc8e9e94f887068dcba6d1b54b5ca893e4609047.jpg

First update ever on our game thanks to the awesome community feedbacks.

Fixes


No more UI blocking bug on game over, yay!
You can now kill enemies with multiple energy by punching them faster.


Updates


Added text on UI
Graphical changes on UI
Hex now moves in the tutorial showing you things better
More crispy image on Bill the Board (so you can finally read the Leaderboards!)
New sounds for the ground selection
New sounds for grabbing
Changed the behavior of the Edges when the enemies suck the energy pillar (;V)


We are working steady on the first major update! As you can see from the image above we are going to release a new enemy in the mix.

Can you guess what this foe does?
Let us know if you like this update.

See you later!

notes.title: Edge Guardian is now LIVE in early access!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26142227/53a9e99d887b559a2b7abf7c284b734abad3ffa7.png

Edge Guardian, the first arcade beat-em-up on the HTC Vive is now live for you to try in early access!

Help us grow our game by trying it out, throwing feedback at us, and showing your love.

After a first round of internal tests, we already changed the following:


 Simplified the control system: now almost every action, except shooting, is handled with the trigger
 Extended tutorial, more reactive and with more runtime info
 Changed some sounds, including the cheesy punch one (thanks to everyone that pointed that out)


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=02Ha_mM16Vw

Please, be aware that during all the early access period, leaderboards and achievements could be erased anytime without warning. We will try to do this as less as possible but at some point it could become inevitable. Thank you for your patience.
